DEFECTS: (1) server.mjs:44 installs no clientError/connect handling, so a method node:http does not know gets Node's bare 400 with no JSON instead of 405/404 ('FOO /api/session' and lowercase 'get' -> 'HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request'), CONNECT gets no reply at all, an 'Expect: weird' request gets 417, and two valid pipelined requests followed by a bad one lose their replies (only '400' came back). (2) lib/model.mjs:72 hands the URL string to http.request, which re-parses it, so MODEL_URL is not sent 'exactly as given': '/v1/./Chat%20x/../y?key=a%2Fb' arrived as '/v1/y?key=a%2Fb' and '/a//b/%2e%2e/c%20d' as '/a//c%20d'. (3) lib/database.mjs:41 opens the connection without readBigInts, so a ticket another tool wrote with id 9007199254740993 makes GET /api/tickets/<id> and the list answer 500 internal error (B and C answer 200 with the exact id). (4) lib/report-filters.mjs:75-76 filters created_by without checking the user exists: created_by=777 with a ticket whose creator row is gone counted 1, spec says an id that is no user's matches none (B and C: 0). (5) lib/crypto.mjs:11,27 use scryptSync inside the write transaction: GET / took 291 ms while 12 logins ran. (6) lib/handlers/static.mjs:6 reads the page files at import, so a missing public file is an uncaught stack trace at startup rather than a 500. TESTS: 27 of 30 injected bugs caught; missed Math.floor in the chart height (test/reports.test.mjs:113 only uses counts that divide evenly), 'next' set when exactly limit rows match (test/api.test.mjs:281) and the comment.create audit target changed to ticket:<id>. No test for unknown methods, CONNECT, big ids or a raw MODEL_URL path. DOCS: README is clear with env table, route table and curl examples, but lists no startup error messages and has the login-throttle sentence and a session example stranded inside the Dashboard section (README.md around the Dashboard heading).
